methodology.split: 60/20/20 chronological; H+1 bars purged at train and validation ends
methodology.entry: Next bar open after completed signal candle
methodology.labels: Gross TP first vs SL first within 30 minutes; ambiguous same-minute touches SL first; timeout forced close; final full-horizon-unavailable bars dropped
methodology.gaps: Adverse gap fills at opening price; favorable gaps capped at TP. Opening TP gap precedes subsequent intrabar SL because its order is observable.
methodology.models: Logistic C=.1; HGB 60 iterations depth 3 leaves 7. Fixed seed. No early-stopping random validation.
methodology.selection: 64 fixed hypotheses per symbol: 2 gross TPs x 2 directions x 2 models x 4 thresholds. Validation max net PnL with >=30 trades; tie first hypothesis. No retraining. Selected policy tested once; same trades repriced for cost stress.
methodology.predictions: Uncalibrated model scores, NOT calibrated win probabilities.
methodology.execution: One position per symbol, no overlapping trades, no signals until strictly after exit bar.
methodology.costs: Gross levels derived from assumed quantities; fixed scenario spread+slippage deducted from every exit. No broker spread path or bid/ask execution evidence.

warnings: PAXGUSDT is exchange-traded gold token, not broker XAUUSDm; BTCUSDT spot is not broker BTCUSD. Proxy results do not establish broker performance.
XAU .01 lot = 1 oz and BTC .01 lot = .01 BTC are UNCONFIRMED contract assumptions; USDT is treated as USD without FX/depeg modeling.

XAU spread .24 based only on user screenshot around 2026-11-04 16:00 server time (Bid 4048.435 Ask 4048.675); .40 wider assumption; commission zero from user; .02 slippage invented scenario, not observed.
BTC spread .20/.50 and .10 slippage are USD PnL cost assumptions, not quotes. Commission zero is an unverified BTC scenario.
Wilson 95% intervals assume independent trades; sequential samples are dependent and selection/multiple testing increases uncertainty. Intervals are descriptive, likely too narrow.
85% is a desired target, never a guarantee. No test optimization or reruns to improve outcomes. High hit rate alone is insufficient.
No MT5 tick data, broker contract verification, financing, execution latency, partial fills, margin or liquidation simulation. Spread is an additive approximation, not bid/ask replay.
Fixed 90-day window selected before market-data inspection. No prior flawed script conclusions used.

metrics.mtm_limitation: Minute-close only, excludes intraminute adverse excursions and margin/liquidation.
Minute-close only, excludes intraminute adverse excursions and margin/liquidation.

conclusion: Research only. No claim of achieving 85% or broker profitability; inspect out-of-sample evidence and collect verified broker ticks/contracts before further evaluation.
